excerpt: This means working with one or more third-party organizations that will receive private versions of our Risk Reports (unredacted or with minimal redactions, as discussed below) and publish comprehensive commentary on them.
paraphrase: Third-party organizations will receive largely unredacted Risk Reports and publish comprehensive commentary.

excerpt: Commentary will address topics including the quality of our reasoning, the validity of our risk assessments, the overall level of risk, and whether the redactions we've made for the public version are reasonable and appropriate.
paraphrase: External commentary will cover reasoning quality, validity of assessments, overall risk level, and reasonableness of redactions.

excerpt: Our intent is for external reviewers' judgments to carry significant weight in the eyes of the public as well as our employees.
paraphrase: External reviewers' judgments are intended to carry significant weight with both the public and employees.

excerpt: But there are no well-established organizations or procedures for this sort of practice, and we are approaching it as an experiment.
paraphrase: Because no well-established organizations or procedures exist for this practice, it is being treated as an experiment.

excerpt: At a minimum, we will complete a full external review process (described below) with at least one external reviewer anytime a Risk Report covers highly capable models and is significantly redacted, defined as follows:
paraphrase: A full external review with at least one reviewer will be completed whenever a Risk Report covers highly capable models and is significantly redacted, as defined below.

excerpt: A model is "highly capable" if we conclude that it crosses the threshold for automated AI R&D described in Section 1.
paraphrase: A model is considered highly capable if it crosses the automated AI R&D threshold defined in Section 1.

excerpt: "Significantly redacted" means that the redactions omit information a reasonable external safety researcher would consider important in evaluating the overall level of risk, such that a reader of only the public version could not meaningfully assess whether they agree with our conclusions.
paraphrase: Significantly redacted means the omissions would prevent a reasonable external safety researcher from meaningfully assessing the risk conclusions from the public version alone.

excerpt: A report shall be deemed significantly redacted if, in the judgment of the RSO, CEO, Board, or LTBT, it meets this description.
paraphrase: The RSO, CEO, Board, or LTBT determine whether a report meets the significantly redacted definition.

excerpt: Note that unredacted reports will be shared with a large number of employees, who will be in a position to raise concerns if they believe the public version meets this description.
paraphrase: Unredacted reports are shared broadly with employees, who can raise concerns about the public version's redaction level.

excerpt: In consultation with the Board and LTBT, we will select external reviewers that:
paraphrase: External reviewers will be selected in consultation with the Board and LTBT, per the criteria below.

context_stem: we will select external reviewers that:
excerpt: Have significant experience and expertise regarding evaluations for dangerous AI capabilities and propensities.
paraphrase: Reviewers must have significant expertise in evaluating dangerous AI capabilities and propensities.

excerpt: It's particularly important that they be knowledgeable about potential ways such evaluations might be misleading (for example, alignment faking).
paraphrase: Reviewers should be knowledgeable about ways evaluations could be misleading, such as alignment faking.

context_stem: we will select external reviewers that:
excerpt: Have reputational and other incentives making them likely to be candid about their assessment of risks, rather than focused on writing comments that Anthropic will approve of.
paraphrase: Reviewers should have incentives favoring candor over pleasing Anthropic.

excerpt: For example, external review parties should not be teams whose revenue, reputation and success depend entirely on Anthropic and similar companies continuing to work with them.
paraphrase: External reviewers should not be entirely economically dependent on Anthropic and similar companies.

context_stem: we will select external reviewers that:
excerpt: Do not have conflicts of interest with respect to Anthropic.
paraphrase: Reviewers must not have conflicts of interest regarding Anthropic.
